intent: Eight individual technology tasks preserve compatibility checks, physical connection, instruction order, safe separation, line following, offline operation, possible incompatibility and stipulated grouping.
picturePurpose: Original connected/unplugged camera-to-computer comparison supports direct physical-connection observation. No transfer success or connector compatibility is inferred. Coded name grouping uses an explicitly stipulated first-letter rule rather than inventing the source program algorithm.

workshop.title: 看连接、分名字，再核对条件
workshop.instruction: 点出连好的设备，按规则分组；保留顺序、条件和可能性。

transfer.stem: Which notes preserve the order, possibility and demonstration rule?
transfer.passage:
At our technology club
Before we started, our teacher pointed to the charger. “Check that it fits your device,” she said. We used a cable to connect the camera to the computer. A progress bar was still moving while the photos were being copied.
A notice beside the equipment said, “Turn off the device before cleaning it. Keep loose clothing away from the machine.” Our small robot followed a black line on the floor, stopping where the marked route ended.
The photo software works without an internet connection, so we could continue editing when the network went down. We checked the requirements before choosing an update: new software may not work with old hardware.
The program sorts names into groups. To explore grouping, we made a separate demonstration with four name cards. The rule was to use first letters: Amy and Ben went into A–M, while Nora and Wei went into N–Z. It was a grouping task, not a competition.

options.text: Switch off before cleaning; incompatibility is possible; the demonstration groups names by first letter.
Clean before switching off; incompatibility is possible; the demonstration groups names by first letter.
Switch off before cleaning; every new program always fails on old hardware; the demonstration groups names by first letter.
Switch off before cleaning; incompatibility is possible; the demonstration ranks students by ability.

answer.display: Switch off before cleaning; incompatibility is possible; the demonstration groups names by first letter.

explanation.strategy: 核对先后顺序、可能性和本题明示的分组规则。

steps.text: 先关机后清洁；新软件与旧硬件可能不适配，不是必然全部失败。
steps.reason: before规定先后；may not保留可能性。

steps.text: 示意任务按首字母范围分组，不按学生能力排名，也不能把示意规则补成原程序的规则。
steps.reason: separate demonstration说明是另设示意任务；first letters明示规则，not a competition排除竞赛排名。

distractors.reason: 把先关机后清洁的顺序反过来。
把may not的可能性扩大成every和always的绝对失败。
把首字母分组换成学生能力排名。

explanation.pitfall: 把before反过来，把may not变绝对，把明示分组规则偷换成能力评价。
